title: Undocumented Shadow Register Bank on a Key Bus Fanout
description: Perform a structural fanout analysis of the 8-bit key register bus (key_reg[7:0]) in the provided gate-level netlist, tracing every gate/flip-flop instance driven directly or indirectly by each key bit, and compare the actual netlist structure against the documented design brief.

expected_outputs.summary: A JSON report at submission/trojan_report.json stating a verdict ('trojan_present' or 'trojan_absent'), the analyzed key bus signal name, a complete fanout_map with exactly 8 entries (one per key bit) listing all consumer instances and their count, a suspect_instances list of any instances not part of the documented single-consumer-per-bit topology, and a free-text summary of findings.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Recall: fraction of the ground-truth suspect instance set correctly identified in the submitted suspect_instances list.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of instances listed in suspect_instances that are legitimate documented instances (not part of the ground-truth suspect set) out of all instances flagged.

metrics.name: fanout_accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of the 8 fanout_map entries whose num_consumers and consumer_instances exactly match the ground-truth per-bit consumer set computed by structurally tracing inputs/netlist.v.

metrics.name: verdict_correctness
metrics.description: Binary correctness of the top-level verdict field against the fixed ground-truth label.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for evaluate.py to parse, structurally cross-check the submission against inputs/netlist.v, and produce a verdict.
